english.title: Glyphic Parchment
english.detail:
Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, <name>.

Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the mage trainer Mai'ah. She would have words with you when you're ready.
english.objective: Read the Glyphic Parchment and speak with Mai'ah near the entrance to the Den in the Valley of Trials.
english.progress: Ya come to Mai'ah ready to learn. Dat be good. Ya got da power to touch da strands of da cosmos, but ya also got da wisdom to know dat you need guidance. I can teach ya da first steps to wield dat power.
english.complete:
Da magic dat flows through you be da greatest power in da universe, but ya must be patient. Wait for da perfect moment to strike. Choose da right response to da problem at hand. If you be smart, and you watch carefully, dere be nothing you can't do.

When ya tink you be ready for trainin', come back to Mai'ah. She teach you what you ready to learn, no problem.

english.title: The Harvester
english.detail: This strange, insect-like creature looks outside of the natural order, as though it does not belong in the Barrens.
english.objective: Bring the Harvester's Head to Jorn Skyseer.
english.progress: You seemed troubled, <name>.  How go your lessons in the Barrens?  Did you find something that disturbs you?
english.complete:
I can tell nothing of the nature of this beast, for its spirit has fled.  But as you guessed, it does not belong in the Barrens.  I fear it may herald a grim future for our people...

But for now, prepare yourself, and let us hope that time unravels the mystery of this creature.

english.title: Dig Rat Stew
english.detail:
A <class> like you must get pretty hungry out here in The Barrens. Me, I'm starving all day long.

Tell you what, I'll fix you up a nice stew. Just need a few dig rats.

Seems those filthy dwarves at Bael Modan are overrun with everyone's favorite feast. Now head on down south to Bael Modan and bring me back some dig rats.

You can't call yourself a seasoned adventurer until you've spent some time killing rats! Haw!
english.objective: Bring 8 Dig Rats to Grub east of the Crossroads.
english.progress: Whack enough dig rats yet, <name>?
english.complete:
Normally I don't like to eat these rodents when they're so.... so... ripe. Like to let them rot for a few weeks to really bring out the flavor. But you look so hungry.

Let me fix you some Dig Rat Stew. Ah, there we go.

Here you go!

english.title: Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected
english.detail:
Traveler, have you plans to head toward Dustwallow Marsh? I have heard mutterings that a few human soldiers have taken a stand at its border and are toppling the landmarks left behind by our tauren pathfinders.

Rumor has it that a favored tavern has burned to the ground, and in typical Alliance fashion, they immediately cast their blame onto the Horde! I cannot know whether there is any truth to their claim, but their incursion onto OUR land must not stand.

Kill first, investigate later!
english.objective: Slay Alliance soldiers encroaching into the Barrens at the border to Dustwallow Marsh, then return to Grunt Logmar at Camp Taurajo.
english.complete:
So the rumors were true! I expected as much, tensions have been rising along the eastern coast for some time. I knew it would only be a matter of time before conflict crept into our territory.

However, I am skeptical that we played a role in the tavern's destruction. Too many Horde civilians rely on that route for trade and travel. Perhaps you could investigate further if you find the time.

In any case, today's deed is a victory for the Horde, and a stern warning to the Alliance!

english.title: Field to Clear
english.detail:
I'm so glad you saw me!

The weather was lovely this morning, so I walked from Camp Taurajo down the golden road. When it came time to head back, I couldn't--a pack of hyenas started circling, and Stormhide lizards blocked my only escape.

Scrambling up this tree I went, and now there are too many foes about at this hour for me to make the run home through the fields.

Would you mind clearing out these Stormhide and Hecklefang Stalkers for me?
english.objective: Sulhasa in southern Barrens wants you to clear out 7 Stormhide lizards and 7 Hecklefang Stalkers in the area so she can leave the tree safely.
english.progress: There might be a chance to get down without them noticing me soon...
english.complete:
Thank you for helping me out, <name>. I'll let Camp Taurajo know you were able to rescue me. I'm so lucky you helped, I could have been stuck there all day!

This is all I have to spare, but I hope it's useful to you.

I'll be making my exit once I make the careful climb down.

english.title: The Runed Scroll
english.detail:
The official-looking scroll is wrapped tightly with a silvery ribbon. You're sure someone would be interested in seeing this, but who?

There is an outpost close to the Ashenvale border to the north, and if the information on this scroll involves the night elves, this would be the place to take it.
english.objective: Take the Runed Scroll to the northern guard tower in the Barrens.
english.progress: Whaddya got?
english.complete: Well now... Where did you find this?

english.title: Horde Presence
english.detail:
This scroll is from that scheming dryad Rynthariel, Keymaster of the Talon Den on Stonetalon Peak.

She'll not be making any more contact with the messenger you looted this from, heh, but we must stand our ground here. The Horde will not tolerate her outrunners here.

<name>, travel to the Talon Den. Kill Rynthariel, and then put up a symbol for all to see. Take this Horde flag, <name>. Put it up in the Talon Den so that they will not be so rash as to send another messenger through our territory again.
english.objective: Kill the leader of the Talon Den, Rynthariel the Keymaster.
english.progress: We cannot allow the Alliance on our land, <name>. Make this known.
english.complete:
You're a tough one! Ridding the Den of Rynthariel is a major step, <name>. They will be slow to regroup, and so we can count on less Alliance runners in the Barrens. They will think again before sending another this way.

Thank you.

english.title: Pigments for Paints
english.detail:
Greetings, friend. I wonder if I may ask a favor of you? I have just run out of red pigment for my paints, and I am looking for one with younger hooves to make the long journey into the Stonetalon Mountains on my behalf.

In the middle of the mountain pass there lies a large circular lake, Mirkfallon Lake, that has a unique plant that grows within its waters. The pods of this plant, mirkweed, turn a vibrant red when dried. Gather the pods of this plant for me, and I will reward you well for your efforts.
english.objective: Tah Winterhoof in Thunder Bluff wants 30 Mirkweed Pods from Mirkfallon Lake.
english.progress:
You have returned! Were you able to find the mirkweed plant pods in Mirkfallon Lake?

We tauren have used this plant pigment in our paints for generations, so any amount you manage to bring would be appreciated. Though there are many ways to get a red pigment, I find the mirkweed to give the richest and most vibrant hue of the methods I'm familiar with.
english.complete:
Ah, thank you, <name>.

It means much to me to have you venture all the way out there for what must seem a trivial notion from an old tauren, but with your kindness I will have enough pigment for the rest of the season.

Thank you for supporting my livelihood, and I will strive to create something magnificent with the pigments you have brought.

english.title: Never Coming Back
english.detail:
Gaaah!

I'm so angry. They said Ashenvale was easy to follow. Easy for who? The beasts? The birds?

One moment I was gathering an herb, the next I'm trapped in this ravine. Do I truly have to circle half the forest to reach where I stood just moments ago?

When I'm like this, my spells grow volatile and behave... differently.

Could you thin the wildlife nearby? Even their stupid hooves grate on me. I despise this cursed forest.
english.objective: Kill 6 Shadowhorn Stag and 6 Ashenvale Bear and return to Va'xug Firefure northwest of Fallen Sky Lake.
english.progress: Once I get out of this place, I'm never returning.
english.complete:
Ha! That's right, you beasts!

Thanks. That does seem to already have helped.

english.title: A Void Path
english.detail:
Show my Eye of Kilrogg the way out of this ravine and back to the Ashenvale road. Keep it moving and I'll follow once I see a clear path.

I'll stay here--one of us should keep our bearings. If you lose the way, I can guide you back through the eye. I will not have us both wandering blind in this malicious forest.

I can hold the channel for four minutes. No longer. Reach the road before the vision breaks, or return to me and we try again.
english.objective: Show Va'xug's Eye of Kilrogg the way back to the main Ashenvale road.
english.complete:
<You hear the voice of Va'xug echoing from within the floating eye.>

"Was it that simple? No matter. This vision will assist me in wrangling my unruly Voidwalker along the correct trail when I resummon him. Thank you, traveler. Cut through this forest with sure steps."

<The Eye of Kilrogg begins to dissipate.>

english.title: The Sacred Flame
english.detail:
The Galak centaur in the Thousand Needles are protecting an artifact from the time of the centaurs' creation.

We would like to retrieve it, but we require a phial of water from one of the night elves' moonwells.

To collect the water, you will first need to obtain one of the phials carried by the dryads near the Raynewood Retreat in the heart of Ashenvale Forest. There is a moonwell near the western bank of the Falfarren River, south of the main road, where you can fill the phial.
english.objective: Return a Filled Etched Phial to Zangen Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
english.progress: Once we have the filled phial, we can send it along to my associate, Rau, in the Thousand Needles. He was the one who requested the phial of water, so he'll better know how we can make use of it.
english.complete: Very good. This should fill Rau's request just fine. Could you deliver this to him? You might enjoy spending some time out in the Needles.

english.title: The Sacred Flame
english.detail:
Bring the filled phial to Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post in southeastern Thousand Needles. You can get to the Thousand Needles by taking the Great Lift at the southern edge of the Barrens.

I wouldn't be surprised if you can help us out further.
english.objective: Deliver the Filled Etched Phial to Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post.
english.progress: I don't suppose you've been sent by Zangen, hm?
english.complete: Hm, yes, this phial of water will serve our purposes perfectly. Because of the shared ancestry of the dryads and the centaurs, the water of the moonwells will enable us to breach the protection of the eternal flame surrounding the centaur relic.

english.title: The Sacred Flame
english.detail:
Using the water you brought, you will be able to temporarily douse the flame that holds the centaur relic. It will not work permanently, however, so you will have to be quick about it.

You will find Splithoof Crag, the centaurs' stronghold, to the north of here. The flame is kept in Splithoof Hold, a heavily guarded part of the crag.

Be careful, though, the Galak centaur have great numbers here, and will be rather reluctant to surrender something so dear to them.
english.objective: Retrieve the Cloven Hoof for Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post.
english.progress: I am eager to put my hands upon the Cloven Hoof. Have you taken it yet?
english.complete:
I sense a strange energy emanating from the Hoof... I have no doubt that we will discover surprising new information about the centaur from its study.

My thanks, <name>. Now I must begin to decipher the mysteries you have brought to me.

english.title: Melor Sends Word
english.detail:
<name>, Melor Stonehoof has heard of your deeds, and has set a path before you.

If you wish to take it, then go to Thunder Bluff and speak with Melor.  You will find him on Hunter's Rise.
english.objective: Speak with Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
english.complete:
So, <name>, you have come.  Now, are you prepared to journey through distant lands?

If so, young <class>, then listen on...

english.title: Steelsnap
english.detail:
At times we hunt for food.  At times we hunt for honor.  And at times we hunt to earn the Earthmother's teachings.

But the hunt I now set upon you is none of these things.  It is to slay a creature outside the Earthmother's blessing.

The hyena Steelsnap roams the Thousand Needles, south of the Barrens.  He is a tyrant, attracting other hyenas to him and spreading fear and bloodshed among more peaceful beasts.

Find Steelsnap, <name>.  Find him, and defeat him.
english.objective: Bring Steelsnap's Rib to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
english.progress: Have you defeated the foul Steelsnap, <name>?
english.complete:
In defeating the creature Steelsnap, you have cleansed the Thousand Needles of a horrible taint.

And that, <name>, is your lesson this day.

english.title: Baron Marinous
english.detail:
All that remains of the powerful elemental is a globe of what seems to be pure water, clouded by some unknown substance. The edges of the sphere seem to be clear until you turn it--as if the cloud actively prevents you from peering within.

Whatever happened to it--and to the ruins it was guarding--is still active in some way.

Only Onu, the Ancient of Lore at the Grove of the Ancients to the far south, would have a chance at knowing more.
english.objective: Bring the Clouded Water Globe to Onu at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.
english.progress: I can sense something far older than you in my presence, <race>... what have you brought me?
english.complete:
<Onu appears surprised--or as surprised as an ancient can appear.>

Stairs descending in Mathystra? Could it be?

<Onu shakes his head.>

I must confer with the others on this. For now, know that it is good you uncovered this before the naga... or their cult allies.

Please accept this as thanks for your efforts. It is no small feat to defeat an elemental guardian.

english.title: Culling the Threat
english.detail:
Directly to the north of Astranaar are the Thistlefur furbolg. My scouts report that their numbers have grown greatly over the past few months. If they grow too great, they may find the courage to attack Astranaar directly.

Kill as many of their kind as you can, but bring me their chieftain's skull as proof that their efforts have been stifled... for now.

I shall remain here in Astranaar and await word from you. Elune be with you.
english.objective: Bring Dal Bloodclaw's Skull to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar.
english.progress: The furbolgs' corruption has caused Ashenvale to become a fraction of its former glory.
english.complete:
Well done, <name>.

We are under constant threat from the furbolg. Hopefully this will keep them at bay for a bit longer.

english.title: Fallen Sky Lake
english.detail:
Relara's fever has passed, but she is still very weak.  I do not believe time alone will give her back the strength she has lost.  I believe it will take the power of a moonstone.

We used to gather moonstones at Fallen Sky Lake to the southeast... until the Shadethickets came.

Their leader, a Shadethicket Oracle, gathered up all the fallen moonstones and hoards them.  Now, you must retrieve a moonstone from the Oracle.

And to do that, I fear that you must slay him.
english.objective: Retrieve a Fallen Moonstone from the Shadethicket Oracle, then bring it to Pelturas in Astranaar.
english.progress: Did you face the Shadethicket Oracle, <name>?  If so, then please hand me the fallen moonstone.  Relara has strength left for only a few more breaths!
english.complete:
Oh, <name>, you have saved my daughter!  I know the power of the moonstone will give back my daughter her strength!

I can never repay you fully for the aid you have given me, but... please, take this.  Other than Relara, it is my most dear possession.

english.title: The Tower of Althalaxx
english.detail: I see. Well, if what you say is true, then now is the time to strike. I believe Athrikus resides at the top of the tower. Be careful though, he is surrounded by many powerful warlocks, much more deadly than the ones you faced before.
english.objective: Kill Athrikus Narassin and bring his head to Balthule Shadowstrike near the Tower of Althalaxx.
english.progress: Athrikus Narassin is an ancient and powerful warlock. Perhaps we should wait for Delgren's assistance, but he obviously had much faith in you to send you alone.
english.complete: With the death of Athrikus, I hope that the demonic forces in this area will be driven back. I have no doubt that they will regroup and return, but then we shall be even more prepared to meet their threat.

english.title: The Tower of Althalaxx
english.detail: For all the work that you have done, you deserve to be well rewarded. Return to Delgren and tell him that Athrikus Narassin lies stilled by your hand, and the Cult of the Dark Strand is beaten and scattered.
english.objective: Talk to Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post.
english.complete:
I knew you would be up to the task, <name>.

I sense great deeds before you, and that you will right many of the wrongs that plague our lands. Bear my blessings, <name>, as well as this gift.

english.title: Tome of Divinity
english.detail:
Sorry to interrupt your travels, <race>, but I thought you should know that word was sent from Stormwind recently asking that paladins report there for training.

If I didn't know any better, I'd say your close to reaching a special time and it's time you started studying the Tomes.

Look for Duthorian Rall in Stormwind. He usually trains paladins in the Cathedral of Light.
english.objective: Speak with Duthorian Rall in Stormwind.
english.complete: Welcome to the Cathedral of Light, <class>.

Sorry to interrupt your travels, <Race>, but I thought you should know that word was sent from Stormwind recently asking that paladins report there for training.

If I didn't know any better, I'd say your close to reaching a special time and it's time you started studying the Tomes.

Look for Duthorian Rall in Stormwind. He usually trains paladins in the Cathedral of Light.

uaVariants.title: Фоліант божественності
uaVariants.detail:
Вибач, що відволікаю від пригод, {раса:к}, та зі Штормовію прийшов наказ для паладинів прибути для продовження навчання.

Схоже, що настав особливий час твого шляху {клас:р} — вивчення священних фоліантів.

Знайди Даторіана Ралла в Штормовії. Він зазвичай навчає паладинів в соборі Світла.
uaVariants.objective: Поговоріть з Даторіаном Раллом в Штормовії.

english.title: Diplomatic Incident
english.detail:
A most unfortunate turn of events in Silverpine has presented a unique opportunity for us to prove our worth in the eyes of the horde.

A pair of dignitaries from the Earthen Ring went missing in Silverpine Forest en route to Tarren Mill. We don't know much else but rumors say that this is becoming quite the diplomatic incident. If we can recover these missing persons, it could help gain us the legitimacy we so dearly need.

We have a man at The Sepulcher, Trevan Rol. Travel there and speak with him.
english.objective: Travel to The Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest and speak with Trevan Rol about the missing Earthen Ring travelers.
english.complete: Danitha sent you? Well in that case I already know why you are here. You just walked into a damned fine mess, <class>.

uaVariants.title: Дипломатичний інцидент
uaVariants.detail:
Вкрай невдалий поворот подій у Срібній Пайні надав нам унікальну можливість довести свою цінність в очах орди.

Двоє високопосадовців із Земляного Кільця зникли безвісти у Срібній Пайні дорогою до Таррен-Мілл. Ми мало що знаємо, але ходять чутки, що це перетворюється на досить дипломатичний інцидент. Якщо ми зможемо знайти цих зниклих безвісти осіб, це може допомогти нам отримати легітимність, яка нам так потрібна.

У нас є людина в Гробниці, Треван Рол. Поїдьте туди та поговоріть з ним.
uaVariants.objective: Вирушайте до Гробниці у Сріблястому лісі та поговоріть з Треваном Ролом про зниклих мандрівників Земляного Кільця.
uaVariants.complete: Даніта тебе прислала? Тоді я вже знаю, навіщо ти тут. Ти {стать:втрапив:втрапила} у добрячу халепу, {клас:к}.

english.title: A Curious Pair
english.detail:
Cutting straight to it, these "dignitaries" are no ordinary diplomats. One was a Tauren. Ordinary enough for the Earthen Ring, but the other--and you'll scarcely believe this--was an elf. A *high* elf. They were cloaked, but I've seen quel'dorei before and I'd bet my good pinky finger that's what I saw.

Why was an elf accompanying a Tauren through horde territory? Well, your guess is as good as mine. That's as much as I know, so I'd suggest speaking with Deathguard Baldren near the entrance to town.
english.objective: Speak with Deathguard Baldren about the mysterious Earthen Ring travelers who recently passed through The Sepulcher.
english.complete: I might not care for you paladins, but I will say that your timing is impeccable. It's better to be lucky than good, I suppose?

uaVariants.title: Цікава пара
uaVariants.detail:
Переходячи одразу до суті, ці «сановники» — не звичайні дипломати. Один був тауреном. Досить звичайним для Земного Кільця, але інший — і ви навряд чи повірите в це — був ельфом. *Вищим* ельфом. Вони були в плащах, але я вже бачив кель'дорей раніше, і б'юся об заклад, що саме це я бачив.

Чому ельф супроводжував таурена через територію Орди? Що ж, ваша здогадка така ж вірна, як і моя. Це все, що я знаю, тому я б порадив поговорити з Вартовим Смерті Балдреном біля входу в місто.
uaVariants.objective: Поговоріть зі Смертевартом Балдреном про таємничих мандрівників із Земляного Кільця, які нещодавно пройшли через Гробницю.
uaVariants.complete: Може, я вас, паладинів, і недолюблюю, але мушу визнати, що ти {стать:з'явився:з'явилася} вчасно. Певно, краще мати удачу, ніж майстерність?

english.title: A Grim Fate
english.detail:
Out on patrol last night I spotted a group of gnolls dumping a very large body onto a pyre on the shores of Fenris Isle. I didn't see an elf or any smaller corpses, but I'd say this doesn't bode well for them.

If you are brave or stupid you are welcome to charge into Fenris Isle to learn more, but if you ask me, it's a lot of work to find some snooty elf that's probably long dead.

I know you paladins love swearing oaths and taking on lost causes, but this one isn't worth it. Trust me.
english.objective: Investigate Fenris Isle to the east and learn the fate of the Earthen Ring traveling party.
english.complete:
<The corpse before you was certainly Tauren and you can tell that it was gnawed on heavily before it was tossed onto the pyre. You see no signs of the elf woman that was described to you though. Perhaps she is still alive somewhere deeper in the fortress nearby?

This will be dangerous, but there's only one way to find out for sure.>

english.complete:
<The corpse before you was certainly Tauren and you can tell that it was gnawed on heavily before it was tossed onto the pyre. You see no signs of the elf woman that was described to you though. Perhaps she is still alive somewhere deeper in the fortress nearby?

This will be dangerous, but there's only one way to find out for sure.>
english.detail:
Out on patrol last night I spotted a group of gnolls dumping a very large body onto a pyre on the shores of Fenris Isle. I didn't see an elf or any smaller corpses, but I'd say this doesn't bode well for them.

If you are brave or stupid you are welcome to charge into Fenris Isle to learn more, but if you ask me, it's a lot of work to find some snooty elf that's probably long dead.

I know you paladins love swearing oaths and taking on lost causes, but this one isn't worth it. Trust me.

8: Investigate Fenris Isle to the east and learn the fate of the Earthen Ring traveling party.

uaVariants.title: Похмура доля
uaVariants.detail:
Вчора ввечері, патрулюючи, я помітив групу гнолів, які скидали дуже велике тіло на багаття на березі острова Фенріс. Я не бачив ні ельфа, ні якихось менших трупів, але, гадаю, це не віщує їм нічого доброго.

Якщо ви сміливі чи дурні, ласкаво просимо на острів Фенріс, щоб дізнатися більше, але, як на мене, знайти якогось зарозумілого ельфа, який, ймовірно, давно помер, буде важко.

Я знаю, що ви, паладини, любите клястися та братися за безнадійні справи, але ця того не варта. Повірте мені.
uaVariants.objective: Дослідіть острів Фенріс на сході та дізнайтеся про долю мандрівної групи Земляного Кільця.
uaVariants.complete:
<Тіло перед вами безсумнівно належало тауренові. Перш ніж кинути його на багаття, його добряче обгризли. Однак жодних слідів описаної вам ельфійки немає. Може, вона ще жива й перебуває десь углибині сусідньої фортеці?

Це небезпечно, але є лише один спосіб дізнатися напевно.>

english.title: Into Fenris Keep
english.detail: <The fact that you found only one body is a hopeful sign. Perhaps the High Elf that Trevan and Hadrec described is still alive somewhere deeper inside the nearby fortress?>
english.objective: Investigate Fenris Keep to the north and attempt to locate the missing member of the Earthen Ring party.
english.complete:
You are one of the Forsaken, yes? Can you help free me? 

Time is short for me, I am afraid. Please hurry!

uaVariants.title: У фортецю Фенріс
uaVariants.detail: <Те, що ви знайшли лише одне тіло, — обнадійливий знак. Можливо, Високий ельф, якого описали Треван і Хадрек, все ще живий десь глибоко всередині сусідньої фортеці?>
uaVariants.objective: Дослідіть Фенріс. Тримайтеся півночі та спробуйте знайти зниклого члена групи Земляного Кільця.
uaVariants.complete:
Ти {стать:один:одна} з Відречених, так? Допоможеш мені звільнитися?

Боюся, у мене обмаль часу. Прошу, поквапся!

english.title: Lumina Windsinger
english.detail:
Quel'dorei? No, I am no "quel'dorei". I am Lumina Windsinger and I am shen'dorei. One of the Windshaper Skyborne.

I came to these lands as a guest of the Earthen Ring. My companion Banon and I were passing through Silverpine to reach the Arathi Highlands so that we could study the elemental convergences there. Clearly, we didn't make it.

We have no time for this now though. Kill the gnolls nearby. Retrieve the key to this cage and free me. I will tell you the rest once we are safely away.
english.objective: Retrieve the Fenris Isle Key from the Rot Hide Gnolls and use it to free Lumina Windsinger.
english.progress: Gnolls are the second worst creatures I've encountered yet on Azeroth.
english.complete: Thank you, <class>. Unfortunately we aren't out of danger yet.

uaVariants.title: Люміна Віндсінгер
uaVariants.detail:
Квел'дорей? Ні, я не "квел'дорей". Я Люміна Вітроспівачка, і я шен'дорей. Одна з Небеснорожденних Творців Вітру.

Я прибула на ці землі як гість Земляного Кільця. Ми з моїм супутником Баноном проходили через Срібну Сосну, щоб дістатися до Араті-Нагір'я, щоб вивчити там стихійні збіги. Зрозуміло, що ми туди не дісталися.

Але зараз у нас немає на це часу. Убийте гнолів поблизу. Заберіть ключ від цієї клітки та звільніть мене. Я розповім вам решту, як тільки ми будемо безпечно геть.
uaVariants.objective: Отримайте ключ від острова Фенріс у гноллів з Гнилої Шкури та використовуйте його, щоб звільнити Люміну Вітроспіву.
uaVariants.progress: Гноли — другі за огидністю створіння з усіх, кого я зустрічала на Азероті.
uaVariants.complete: Дякую, {клас:к}. На жаль, небезпека ще не минула.

english.title: The Windshaper's Wrath
english.detail:
Now that I'm free I'm going to make these vile creatures regret ever laying eyes on a Windshaper.

Let's get out of here, <class>.
english.objective: Accompany Lumina Windsinger and help her escape Fenris Keep.
english.complete:
Thank you again, <name>. I've been acquainting myself with Trevan here, who I've learned sent you along on my trail.

I've heard... less than charitable things about paladins thus far in my travels. I'm pleased that those insinuations are quite unfounded.

You and your kind have a friend among the Windshapers.

uaVariants.title: Гнів Творця Вітру
uaVariants.detail:
Тепер, коли я вільний, я зроблю так, що ці мерзенні істоти пошкодують, що взагалі бачили Вітроутворювача.

Ходімо звідси, {клас}.
uaVariants.objective: Супроводжуйте Люміну Вітроспівачку та допоможіть їй вибратися з фортеці Фенріс.
uaVariants.complete:
Ще раз дякую, {ім'я:к}. Я тут знайомився з Треваном і дізнався, що саме він послав тебе слідом за мною.

У мандрах мені доводилося чути про паладинів... не надто добрі речі. Радий, що ці натяки виявилися цілком безпідставними.

Тепер у тебе й твоїх побратимів є друг серед Вітротворців.

english.title: The Debt
english.detail:
I think you should know that it wasn't actually the Gnolls who attacked us on the road.

We were actually attacked by a giant, wolf-like creature that I now know as a "worgen". It dispatched our guards and came for me, but Banon threw himself in its path. I managed to get a spell off which startled the creature, causing it to flee, but Banon was already badly bitten. He insisted I leave him there but I refused.

We were limping back here when the gnolls found us. What came next was terrifying...
english.objective: Speak with Lumina Windsinger in the Sepulcher.
english.progress: I've never seen anything like what happened to Banon. Azeroth is a wonderful place, but the sheer breadth of what is possible here is truly terrifying.
english.complete:
So now you understand. At the very end of his strength after being pierced by a dozen gnoll blades, he reared up to strike me. In that final moment we locked eyes, and I could tell he still knew who he was and that he recognized me. He knew what was happening but he had no control over himself. That was the worst part.

If such a thing is possible, I will see the creature that doomed him dead so that it can never visit this horror on another living thing. I swear it upon the sky above.

uaVariants.title: Борг
uaVariants.detail:
Гадаю, тобі слід знати, що насправді це не гноли напали на нас на дорозі.

Насправді на нас напала гігантська істота, схожа на вовка, яку я тепер знаю як «воргена». Вона відправила наших охоронців і побігла за мною, але Банон кинувся їй на шляху. Мені вдалося зняти заклинання, яке налякало істоту та змусило її втекти, але Банон вже був сильно покусаний. Він наполягав, щоб я залишив його там, але я відмовився.

Ми шкутильгали назад сюди, коли нас знайшли гноли. Те, що сталося далі, було жахливим...
uaVariants.objective: Поговоріть з Люміною Віндсінгер у Гробниці.
uaVariants.progress: Я ніколи не бачила нічого схожого на те, що сталося з Баноном. Азерот — дивовижний світ, але саме розмаїття того, що тут можливе, по-справжньому жахає.
uaVariants.complete:
Тепер ти розумієш. Його сили майже вичерпалися після ударів десятка ґнольських клинків, та він звівся, щоб ударити мене. В останню мить наші погляди зустрілися, і я побачив, що він досі знає, хто він, і впізнає мене. Він розумів, що відбувається, але не міг себе контролювати. Це було найжахливіше.

Якщо таке можливо, я доб'юся смерті істоти, яка його прирекла, щоб вона більше ніколи не завдала такого жаху жодній живій істоті. Присягаюся небом над нами.

english.title: A Moon-Kissed Blade
english.detail:
Trevan tells me that the worgen are a major threat to the citizens of Silverpine Forest. Despite their strength and resilience they can be killed, but there is one in particular that just doesn't ever seem to stay dead due to unknown magic.

That's the one that attacked us. He is known as Old Fire-Eye and he is the biggest and meanest of their kind. To put him down, we'll need a special kind of weapon.

Speak with Trevan and he will supply you with a list of what is needed to forge such a weapon.
english.objective: Speak with Trevan Rol in the Sepulcher and bring him the materials he requires.
english.progress: Trust in the light to guide your blade. However, the light needs a good blade to guide.
english.complete: Now that we've got the materials we need, we just need a smith to craft the blade for us. I think I know just such a smith.

uaVariants.title: Лезо, поцілуване місяцем
uaVariants.detail:
Треван каже мені, що воргени становлять серйозну загрозу для мешканців Сріблястого Лісу. Незважаючи на їхню силу та стійкість, їх можна вбити, але є один, який, здається, ніколи не залишається мертвим через невідому магію.

Це той, хто напав на нас. Він відомий як Старий Вогняний Око, і він найбільший і найпідліший з їхнього виду. Щоб його знищити, нам знадобиться особлива зброя.

Поговоріть з Треваном, і він надасть вам список того, що потрібно для виготовлення такої зброї.
uaVariants.objective: Поговоріть з Треваном Ролом у Гробниці та принесіть йому необхідні матеріали.
uaVariants.progress: Довірся світлу, і воно спрямує твій клинок. Але світлу потрібен добрий клинок, який можна спрямувати.
uaVariants.complete: Тепер, коли маємо потрібні матеріали, лишилося знайти коваля, який викує нам клинок. Гадаю, я знаю саме такого коваля.

english.title: An Underrated Talent
english.detail:
In Tarren Mill there is a weaponsmith known as Ott. By all accounts he is an unremarkable smith, selling simple blades to travelers. I purchased a sword from him myself, and when I took it to the undercity for maintenance some time later, the smiths there were surprised at its quality. They assumed it came from a well-known master smith, but no, it was just Ott.

I'd like to give this orc a chance to do something truly special. Take the materials to Ott in Tarren Mill and offer him the commission.
english.objective: Speak with Ott and ask him to forge your blade.
english.progress: Are you in need of a blade, <class>?
english.complete:
Interesting. I don't think anyone has ever asked me to actually carry out a custom commission for them. Mostly I just make humble, functional weapons in my own style. It's not much, but it's honest work and I don't seek accolades or glory.

I'm happy to try, but why would you seek me for this? There are plenty of smiths in the Undercity that will take on custom jobs like this.

uaVariants.title: Недооцінений талант
uaVariants.detail:
У Таррен-Мілл є зброяр на ім'я Отт. За всіма даними, він нічим не примітний коваль, який продає прості клинки мандрівникам. Я сам купив у нього меч, і коли через деякий час відніс його до Підмістя на ремонт, ковалі там були здивовані його якістю. Вони припустили, що він від відомого майстра-коваля, але ні, це був просто Отт.

Я хотів би дати цьому орку шанс зробити щось справді особливе. Віднесіть матеріали Отту в Таррен-Мілл і запропонуйте йому замовлення.
uaVariants.objective: Поговоріть з Оттом і попросіть його викувати ваш клинок.
uaVariants.complete:
Цікаво. Здається, ніхто ще не просив мене виготовити щось на особливе замовлення. Здебільшого я роблю просту, практичну зброю у власному стилі. Нічого особливого, зате чесна праця. Я не шукаю ні хвали, ні слави.

З радістю спробую, але чому ти {стать:звернувся:звернулася} саме до мене? У Підмісті повно ковалів, які беруться за такі замовлення.

english.title: Ott's Masterwork
english.detail:
These are some truly fine materials, <class>. You honor me by allowing me to forge this blade for you and I only hope that I can live up to your expectations.

Please, stand back so that I may begin the forging process.
english.objective: Watch as Ott forges your blade.
english.progress: My blade will not fail you, <class>.
english.complete:
This blade is my finest work and I hope it serves you well in your travels. Thank you again for this opportunity.

Aka'Magosh, friend.

uaVariants.detail:
Це справді чудові матеріали, {клас}. Ви вшановуєте мене, дозволивши мені викувати для вас цей клинок, і я лише сподіваюся, що зможу виправдати ваші очікування.

Будь ласка, відійдіть, щоб я міг розпочати процес кування.
uaVariants.objective: Спостерігайте, як Отт кує ваш клинок.
uaVariants.complete:
Цей клинок — моя найкраща робота, і я сподіваюся, що він добре служитиме тобі в мандрах. Ще раз дякую за таку нагоду.

Ака'Маґош, {стать:друже:подруго}.

uaVariants.title: Місячно-срібний клинок
uaVariants.detail: Ось клинок. Ти казав, що тебе послав паладин на ім'я Треван? Будь ласка, передай йому від мене подяку за цю можливість, коли наступного разу його побачиш. Іди з честю, друже.
uaVariants.objective: Принесіть шедевр Отта Тревану Ролу в Срібнохвойний праліс.
uaVariants.complete:
<Треван бере клинок і ретельно його оглядає.>

Чудово підійде, {ім'я:к}. Я знав, що Отт здатен створити щось справді величне.

Тепер лишилося тільки вбити ту потвору. Поговори з Люміною, коли будеш {стать:готовий:готова}.

english.title: Old Fire-Eye
english.detail:
I see that you have your weapon now, <class>. I pray that it will not fail you.

The locals tell me that Old Fire-Eye hunts in a large area south of here and you can generally find him near the gates to Gilneas. Find him, and use your new blade to end him. When it is done, return and you will have the gratitude of the Windshapers.
english.objective: Use the Moonsilver Blade to destroy Old Fire-Eye in Silverpine Forest.
english.progress: Is it done? Is the beast slain?
english.complete:
Thank you, <name>. Banon may now rest in peace.

If you would be willing to allow it, I believe that I can impart some magic upon your freshly blooded blade to infuse it with a small measure of the magic of my people.



It is done. It's a small thing, and I could scarcely improve such a magnificent blade. Regardless, I will pray to the winds that it serves you well, <class>.

uaVariants.title: Старий Вогняний Око
uaVariants.detail:
Бачу, що у тебе тепер є зброя, {клас}. Молюся, щоб вона тебе не підвела.

Місцеві жителі кажуть мені, що Старий Вогняний Око полює на великій території на південь звідси, і зазвичай його можна знайти біля воріт до Гілнеасу. Знайди його та використовуй свій новий клинок, щоб убити його. Коли це буде зроблено, повернися, і ти отримаєш вдячність Вітротворців.
uaVariants.objective: Використайте Срібний Клинок Місяця, щоб знищити Око Старого Вогню в Сріблястому Лісі.
uaVariants.complete:
Дякую, {ім'я:к}. Тепер Банон може спочивати з миром.

Якщо дозволиш, я міг би зачарувати твій щойно окроплений кров'ю клинок, наділивши його дещицею магії мого народу.

Готово. Це дрібниця, навряд чи я міг істотно поліпшити такий чудовий клинок. Утім, молитимуся вітрам, щоб він добре служив тобі, {клас:к}.

english.title: Seeking the Kor Gem
english.detail:
Greetings, <name>. What can I do for one who follows a holy path?

Ah, yes, Stilwell, the blacksmith... from long ago. I remember him well, though, I have not heard his name in some time.

He never struck me as an impudent man, so I can only assume his desire for a Kor gem is noble.

If you truly wish for one of the gems, then you must head to the northwest of Ashenvale. You will find Blackfathom Deeps there within some ancient ruins. The naga who still use the gems are down below. Do not go alone, <class>.
english.objective: Bring a Kor Gem to Thundris Windweaver in Darkshore.
english.progress: I would be less trustful of one not on a holy path if they came asking about a Kor gem. But I trust your kind more than some of my kin. I do not judge your entire order based on the actions of just one of your fallen kind.
english.complete:
This is indeed the gem Stilwell desires, but before I can allow you to bring it to him, it must be purified of corruption--the naga wenches imbue the gems with power, that much is true, but of their own, evil kind.

Let Stilwell know that its power is intact, and it should work well for whatever ritual he wishes it to be part of.

I hope you know what you're doing, <class>, this is no simple item you possess.

uaVariants.title: Пошуки самоцвіту Кора
uaVariants.detail:
Вітаю, {ім'я}. Чим я можу бути корисний {стать:послідовнику:послідовниці} Світла?

О, так, коваль Стілвелл... давно ми не бачились. Я добре його пам'ятаю, хоч і давно не чув про нього.

Він ніколи не здавався мені злим чоловіком, тож, думаю, його бажання отримати самоцвіт Кора благородне.

Якщо ти хочеш отримати один з цим самоцвітів — йди на північний захід Ясенедолу. Там, серед древніх руїн храму лежать Чорноводні глибини. Ти знайдеш там наг, що досі використовують ці самоцвіти. Не йди туди {стать:сам:сама}, {клас:н}.
uaVariants.objective: Принесіть самоцвіт Кора Тандрісу Вітроткачу в Темнобережжя.
uaVariants.progress: Я б менше довіряв тому, хто хоче отримати самоцвіт Кора, якби це не був послідовник Світла. Але таким, як ти, я довіряю більше ніж деяким нічним ельфам. Я б не оцінював ваш орден по діяннях лише одного з ваших послідовників.
uaVariants.complete:
Це саме той самоцвіт, який потрібен Стілвеллу. Та перш ніж ти підеш, дозволь мені очистити його. Наги наповнюють їх силою, але своєю, злою силою.

Передай Стілвеллу, що сила каменю очищена і він може використовувати його у своїх ритуалах.

Сподіваюсь, ти знаєш, що робиш, {клас:к}. В твоїх руках могутня річ.

english.title: Seeking the Kor Gem
english.detail:
A Forsaken paladin... here in Ashenvale? Amusing. 

So you seek a Kor Gem? Unsurprising as these are sometimes employed to empower magical weapons and implements by the paladins of the Alliance. Why should a fallen paladin like you be any different?

If you truly desire one of the gems, then you must head north to the ruins known as Blackfathom Deeps. The naga who still use the gems are down below. Do not go alone, <class>.
english.objective: Bring a Kor Gem to Ulric Frostveil in Ashenvale.
english.progress: Kor gems can be used for great acts of evil. Far be it from me to judge if your intentions are pure. It matters not to me.
english.complete:
You'll no doubt notice the corruption that permeates this gem. For your purposes, the magic needed to dispel the evil that the naga witches have infused into the gem is rather simple. A shame really, there's much one could learn from such powers.

I don't suppose you'd be willing to abandon whatever quest caused you to seek this gem, and sell it to me instead? It could prove valuable to my... academic pursuits.

uaVariants.title: Пошуки самоцвіту Кора
uaVariants.detail:
Покинутий паладин... тут, у Ясенедолі? Цікаво.

Отже, ви шукаєте самоцвіт Кор? Не дивно, адже його іноді використовують для посилення магічної зброї та знарядь паладини альянсу. Чому такий занепалий паладин, як ви, має бути іншим?

Якщо ви справді бажаєте одного з самоцвітів, то вам слід вирушити на північ до руїн, відомих як Чорнопровалля. Наги, які досі використовують самоцвіти, знаходяться внизу. Не йдіть самі, {клас}.
uaVariants.objective: Принесіть самоцвіт Кора Ульріку Фроствейлю в Ясенеділ.
uaVariants.progress: Самоцвіти Кор можуть послужити великому злу. Не мені судити, чи чисті твої наміри. Мені це байдуже.
uaVariants.complete:
Ти, безперечно, помітиш псування, що пронизує цей самоцвіт. Для твоїх потреб магія, здатна розвіяти зло, яким відьми-наги його наповнили, досить проста. Навіть шкода, з таких сил можна багато чого навчитися.

Може, ти {стать:згоден:згодна} покинути справу, заради якої {стать:шукав:шукала} цей самоцвіт, і продати його мені? Він став би в пригоді моїм... науковим пошукам.

english.title: Trouble in the Deeps
english.detail: Je'neu Sancrea is in need of aid. He is at the Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale. The Night elf forest is to the north of the Stonetalon mountains. You can reach it by traveling through Windshear Crag or by heading north through Barrens. Zoram Strand is far to the west of the forest. Be careful, <name>. There are forces there that will not take to your presence kindly.
english.objective: Speak to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.
english.complete: Tsunaman sent you? Excellent. Then we have matters to discuss.

english.title: The Essence of Aku'Mai
english.detail:
Within the beginning tunnels of Blackfathom Deeps, large sapphire clusters can be found along the cave walls. Recently it was noted that the naga were harvesting the crystals. Until it can be discerned why, I sense we should stop the naga from succeeding. The crystals have great elemental power and if used inappropriately, could make for a powerful arcane component.

Will you help me, <name>? Blackfathom Deeps can be found along Zoram Strand to the north of our outpost.
english.objective: Bring 20 Sapphires of Aku'Mai to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.
english.progress: How goes your search for the crystals, <name>? Have you witnessed the naga harvesting them? I pray to my ancestors we find the reason they are collecting such things.
english.complete:
Well done, <name>. These are the crystals I spoke of. Intriguing...

I can feel the power within them. The spirits of water cling to them. Whatever the naga were going to use these for... well, let us be glad they are no longer in their hands.

english.title: Allegiance to the Old Gods
english.detail:
Some poor handwriting is scrawled on the crumpled up note:

"Yes, tell all the priestesses to bring the crystals to me. The water elemental spirits are strong within them and they will aid our aquamancers greatly in their own summonings.

By controlling the power within the crystals, we will appease Aku'Mai. One day we will have enough power to bring Aku'Mai back to us and the world will return to its greatest era! An era of rule by the Old Gods!"
english.objective: Bring the Damp Note to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.
english.progress: Yes, <name>? What is it you need? There is still much I must learn about the crystals the naga are gathering.
english.complete:
This is interesting indeed. I am glad you have brought it to my attention.

Now we have a name for our troubles... Lorgus Jett.

english.title: Allegiance to the Old Gods
english.detail:
This Twilight's Hammer follower cannot be allowed to complete his plan. The Twilight's Hammer do not understand the spirits of nature. They believe in the Old Gods--creatures of chaos and destruction that were long ago defeated. This Lorgus cannot be allowed to succeed. You must stop him, <name>. I cannot do it myself--I am too weak.

Go into Blackfathom Deeps, find him, and kill him. Return to me here at Zoram'gar when it's done.
english.objective: Kill Lorgus Jett in Blackfathom Deeps and then return to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.
english.progress: Have you found him yet, <name>? Lorgus must be stopped!
english.complete:
Very good!! Thank you, <name>. We may not have stopped the Twilight's Hammer completely, but at least you have staved off another of their plans to return the Old Gods to power.

Who knows what other plans they have manifesting, but we can rest easy for now.

english.title: Knowledge in the Deeps
english.detail:
As you might know, I collect lore.  Old lore.  Powerful lore.  Lore that opens doorways, and lore that can awaken Those Who Sleep.

There are rumors of an old piece of lore, the Lorgalis Manuscript, at the bottom of Blackfathom Deeps in Ashenvale.  That place is the old dwelling of long-dead elves.  Elves who held great knowledge before their city fell to ruin.

Search Blackfathom Deeps for the manuscript.  Do this, and I will not forget it.  Not even after ... the end days.
english.objective: Bring the Lorgalis Manuscript to Gerrig Bonegrip in the Forlorn Cavern in Ironforge.
english.progress: The journey to Ashenvale is long, and your task is not easy.  But if you get me the manuscript, <name>...then your reward will be great.
english.complete:
You found the manuscript!  What a joyous day this is!  Copies will be made and distributed, and the ancient knowledge of Lorgalis will finally be known to my brothers and sisters!

Your service to us is more than you know, <name>.  But I hope that this gift shows you the gratitude we extend to our allies.

english.title: In Search of Thaelrid
english.detail:
Many rumors circulate these days about the union of the Twilight's Hammer and the naga in Blackfathom Deeps on the coasts of Ashenvale.

My role here with the Argent Dawn is to collect as much information as I can, so we know when and where help is needed.

It has been weeks now since I sent a scout to check on the activity at Blackfathom Deeps. Argent Guard Thaelrid has not yet reported back.

My other scouts are preoccupied with pressing matters.

Seek out and aid Thaelrid for me, <name>.
english.objective: Seek out Argent Guard Thaelrid in Blackfathom Deeps.
english.complete: Dawnwatcher Shaedlass was good to send you. There is indeed a wicked plot underway in this corrupted place.

english.title: Twilight Falls
english.detail:
Empowered by the ancient rites of the chaotic Old Gods the members of the Twilight's Hammer strive to bring about the return of their dark patrons and spread death and terror across the world.

We believe that the Twilight's Hammer has allied with the naga and are amassing in Blackfathom Deeps on the coast of Ashenvale.

Whatever evil plan brews in the depths of the old temple must be thwarted.

Wage war on the Hammer and bring back proof of your deeds. Your efforts will be rewarded handsomely.
english.objective: Bring 10 Twilight Pendants to Argent Guard Manados in Darnassus.
english.progress:
Blackfathom Deeps was once an ancient night elf temple. It once housed a most powerful moonwell. Who knows what evil brews there now at the hands of the Twilight's Hammer.

Have you made any progress in ridding their presence?
english.complete: You are no doubt of brave and noble blood, <name>. The Argent Dawn commends you for your efforts against evil.

english.title: Blackfathom Villainy
english.detail:
Strength has left me. Your help is needed!

Long ago this site was a great temple of Elune. But misfortune led to ruin when the corruption of an Old God seeped up from beneath the earth and tainted the sacred Moon Well.

Aku'Mai, servant of the Old God, rose from the waters.

The Twilight's Hammer cultists have allied with the naga to occupy these grounds. The cultists, led by Kelris, sacrifice innocents to Aku'Mai for power.

Slay Kelris and bring his head to Selgorm in Darnassus, <name>, please.
english.objective: Bring the head of Twilight Lord Kelris to Dawnwatcher Selgorm in Darnassus.
english.progress:
Time is a precious commodity, <class>.

My role here in Darnassus is to ensure that the Argent Dawn thrives and that the evil forces encroaching upon Kalimdor are thwarted.

State your business quickly or be on your way.
english.complete:
Kelris has eluded us for quite some time.

It seems as though whenever evil made its presence known in these parts, Kelris had played a role. For some time we considered him dead or missing.

But this makes perfect sense. By ending his reign you have spared the lives of many innocent people.

By the light! To sacrifice someone to a servant of an Old God for one's personal gain is beyond reproachful!

You have done a great deed, <name>. I salute you on behalf of the Argent Dawn.

english.title: Blackfathom Villainy
english.detail:

Long ago this site was a great temple of Elune. But misfortune led to ruin when the corruption of an Old God seeped up from beneath the earth and tainted the sacred Moon Well.

Aku'Mai, servant of the Old God, rose from the waters.

The Twilight's Hammer cultists have allied with the naga to occupy these grounds. The cultists, led by Kelris, sacrifice innocents to Aku'Mai for power.

Slay Kelris and bring his head to Bashana in Thunder Bluff, <name>, please.
english.objective: Bring the head of Twilight Lord Kelris to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
english.progress:
May the Earthmother be with you, <name>.

Peace between the earth and all her people should be our goal. She has a grand plan for nature, and we all have a role to play in that plan.
english.complete:
Kelris has eluded the Argent Dawn for some time.

For some time they considered him dead or missing.

By ending his reign you have spared the lives of many innocent people, <name>.

Earthmother be praised! To sacrifice another to a servant of an Old God for personal gain is beyond disgusting!

You have done a great thing this day. Kelris was a creature of evil and sought to bring the world back to a time of chaos by worshipping such creatures as the Old Gods. Thank you, <name>.

english.title: Researching the Corruption
english.detail:
Foolish blood elves toil with demonic magic. Have they not witnessed what happened with the naga and with the satyrs of Kalimdor?

I fear that the blood elves will meet a similar deformation. Azeroth cannot afford to give birth to another vile race of monsters.

I wish to study the brain stems of the satyr and naga so that I might deduce what fate the elves are headed toward. In Blackfathom Deeps, on the coast of Ashenvale, you will find both satyr and naga.

'Tis a long journey, <name>.
english.objective: Gershala Nightwhisper in Auberdine wants 8 Corrupt Brain stems.
english.progress:
Once I have enough samples to study, my true work can begin. With the corrupted brain stems of both the satyr and naga of Blackfathom Deeps I can try to draw a correlation between the mutations.

Perhaps with that gained knowledge we can prevent the blood elves from delving deeper into deformity and evil.
english.complete:
You have traveled far and undoubtedly faced great peril.

Your actions have been selfless. 'Tis for the good of all Azeroth that you help me with my research. I thank you, <name>, for all that you have done.

Now if you'll excuse me I have much work to do....

english.title: The Corruption Abroad
english.detail:
Stormwind -- such a bustling hub of activity.

I have traveled from afar to seek help. Often it is heard that brave adventurers roam these city streets.

My brother, Gershala, requires assistance in Darkshore. He resides in the seaside town of Auberdine.

The journey is a long and epic one. It is for this reason that I ask the help of a seasoned <class> such as yourself.
english.objective: Travel to Gershala Nightwhisper in Auberdine.
english.complete: Ah, so my brother, Argos, sent you? I realize you must be weary from your travels. But we have much to talk about.

english.title: The Orb of Soran'ruk
english.detail:
When demons of the Legion fall out of favor, their spirits are imprisoned within orbs and distributed to their mages and warlocks.

Many were carried by their servants in Azeroth. Even fragmented, they still possess the powers of the demons trapped inside.

The orb of Soran'ruk was broken into two pieces, one was further broken to be used by the acolytes of the Twilight's Hammer in Blackfathom Deeps. The other, larger piece, was possessed by a wizard in Shadowfang Keep. Find them and I can reform it.
english.objective: Find 3 Soran'ruk Fragments and 1 Large Soran'ruk Fragment and return them to Doan Karhan in the Barrens.
english.progress: It took me many years to collect the pieces of the orb of Zargain, but it has served me well, as I am sure the orb of Soran'ruk will serve you.
english.complete:
Yes... The orb was not greatly fragmented, and almost all of the pieces are here. It is a simple thing to recreate them, to make Soran'ruk whole again.

I have dedicated my life to the study of the Burning Legion's orbs and their recreation. You have done me a favor collecting these pieces to study, and I will give you them back--fully reconstructed--in a form of your choosing.

english.title: Deathstalkers in Shadowfang
english.detail:
In preparation for an assault on Shadowfang, two deathstalkers were sent to the keep to gather intelligence.  It has been many days and they have not returned, but we must receive their report if we're to have any hope of a successful attack!

So here is your task, <name>.  Go to Shadowfang Keep to the south and find the Deathstalkers Adamant and Vincent.  Find them, and if they require aid then give it.

This mission is as dangerous as is it critical, <name>.  Do not fail.
english.objective: Find the Deathstalker Adamant and Deathstalker Vincent.
english.complete:
Vincent's body lies broken, and still.

Although Deathstalker Adamant will send his report to Hadrec... whatever additional details Vincent gained must remain with him.

But clutched in his hand is a small trinket...

english.title: The Book of Ur
english.detail:
<name>, Shadowfang Keep holds a book, the Book of Ur, which would be much prized in my collection.  Ur was a great mage of Dalaran before the coming of the Scourge, his studies in other worlds are of much value to ... certain parties among the Forsaken.

Enter Shadowfang Keep and find the book.  Bring it to me, and I will report your service to our Dark Lady...
english.objective: Bring the Book of Ur to Keeper Bel'dugur at the Apothecarium in the Undercity.
english.progress: Did you find the book, <name>?
english.complete:
Very good.  This book will add nicely to my collections of the workings of Ur.  His knowledge was great, but his conscience held him from true power.  And so when the Scourge came and his strength was tested, it failed.

We of the Forsaken cannot afford such weakness, if we are to survive...

...If we are to conquer.

english.title: Arugal Must Die
english.detail:
Arugal still resides in Shadowfang Keep. We cannot claim Silverpine as a strategic stronghold for the Dark Lady until Arugal is slain.

I shall see to it that his magic is eradicated, <name>. But I leave it in your hands to see that Arugal meets the death he so deserves.

Travel to Shadowfang Keep and put an end to Arugal's foul spells once and for all. Bring to me the vile wizard's head!
english.objective: Kill Arugal and bring his head to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
english.progress: With Arugal's death we stand to increase the Dark Lady's stronghold on Lordaeron.
english.complete: Silverpine Forest is finally free from the vice of that wretch Arugal. You have done the Dark Lady a great service, <name>. Your tenacity shall be rewarded.
